g.text: This is a one-chassis Framework test. It does not invoke
evpn-cni, Multus, CNI ADD/CHECK/DEL, or a NAD.
reserve exact topology; deploy native kind + FRR
verify ownership, readiness and management CA
BGPConfiguration CRD -> k8gobgp reconciliation -> managed gobgpd.
Manager + daemon share one upstream DaemonSet image.
Framework clients use local Unix gRPC; upstream Netlink writers are disabled.
create identity-owned netns and veth attachments
read native local advertisement FDB / neighbors
complete dump plus validated OVN endpoint provenance
AddPath local Type-2 MAC and MAC/IP; retain UUID
validate route identity, RT, VNI, and next hop
ping from local endpoint to remote workload
forward through OVN/OVS and EVPN overlay
correlate five packet captures and runtime snapshots
DeletePath exact owned UUIDs for A
verify A withdrawn and B retained
ping surviving endpoint B and remote workload
verify survivor forwarding in both directions
observe endpoint B removal and reconcile export
DeletePath exact owned UUIDs for B
wait for exporter ownership receipts to empty
verify owned state removed; preserve foreign state
collect diagnostics; destroy exact owned topology
owned resources absent; unrelated resources preserved
NB-to-SB binding and ovn-controller programming are asynchronous.
The test checks resulting binding, OVS state, real traffic, and
packet captures; an API success alone is not a forwarding PASS.
Type-2 import/export is explicitly configured for this test and
remains disabled by default in the standard deployment.
